d:
Desh ki rajdhani dilli men 16 navanbar ko paryavran karyakarta, aaisa ke neta, student organaizeshan ke pratinidhimandal aur kaee log paryavran mantri bhupendr yadav se milne ki mang ko lekar mantralay ke daftar ke pas jute the. halanki, is vaqt paryavran mantri turki men aayojit COP31 men bharat ka pratinidhitv karne pahunche hain. eyar polyushan par sarkar ki javabdehi mang rahe in logon ne kya kaha? dekhie ye vidiyo.
Riport: shubh rana aur dipak jasrotiya

BBC News hindi ko chunen aur paie nyuz alart, laiv tivi, podkast... sab ek jagah.
